newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money rates unchanged in quite trade.
newsitem.headline: German call money rates unchanged in quite trade.

text.p: German call money rates remained steady at about 3.00 percent on Thursday despite a slight setback in liquidity levels.
Traders said that although reserve levels decline by around 4.0 billion marks, the market was still viewed as sufficiently liquid and rates had not been pushed up.
Daily reserves held at the Bundesbank fell to 40.4 billion marks on Wednesday from 44.3 billion on Tuesday, while the average monthly reserves dipped to 43.0 from 43.9 on Tuesday.
